_comment: SystemConfig shipping defaults enable every registered system. Explicit enabled:false opts out. sim.* may change authoritative state and contributes to the config hash; render.* is render-only and excluded from hashes.

sim._ecology_comment: Creature-brain tuning. enabled:false -> the compiled defaults are used (byte-identical). Set enabled:true to apply these values; the shown values ARE the defaults, so flip enabled alone changes nothing until you tweak a number. Levers: energy/sleep cadence, hunger/stamina pacing, herd cohesion (herd_weight/alignment_weight), predator reach (catch_radius/satiation).
sim._fullcontrol_comment: Per-system creature tuning. Each enabled:false -> compiled defaults (byte-identical); the shown values ARE the defaults. Edit a number to tune live. sim.* are hashed when enabled; shipping defaults keep all registry flags ON; explicit false selects compiled tuning.
sim._hydrology_weather_comment: Weather-driven rain enters finite hydrology through integer-quantized per-cell precipitation. Enabling it deliberately changes the world hash.
sim._weather_events_comment: Deterministic Markov weather-event epochs are exposed through GameSession::CurrentWeatherEvent. OFF -> always Clear/0 (byte-identical); consumers must also be participants.
sim._water_high_res_comment: High-resolution water: 16x16 (1 m) cells per chunk instead of the Medium 8x8 (2 m) explicit fallback; the 4096-cell budget then sims 16 chunks/tick instead of 64. Flow constants are resolution-scaled, so physics per simulated step matches Medium. Chunks carrying active edge flux are scheduled ahead of the rotating cursor, so active flow fronts advance every tick at either resolution while the cursor share keeps every awake chunk starvation-free; Medium retains its rotating window byte-for-byte. High still costs ~4x more for first-time grid seeding and a few percent more steady-state solver time. The resolution is baked into the hashed mm grids, so every peer must match; a save at another resolution migrates in one pass at load. Activation deliberately changes the world hash.
sim._aether_state_comment: The stateful energy-field layer uses world-anchored sparse pages and an integer kernel; its sub-hash is folded into the aether hash slot. OFF -> no allocation, no tick work, zero hash bytes, and byte-identical saves. Activation deliberately changes the world hash.
sim._active_regions_comment: Enabled by default: persistent regions restore the absolute simulation tick and calendar across save/load. Explicit false selects the legacy clock path.

render._spawn_comment: Client-only ambient living-world spawn (never hashed). enabled:false -> compiled defaults. Tune how many creatures/ants populate the world + their speeds.
render._living_atmosphere_comment: Live weather, aether response, and snow cover form the default living-atmosphere presentation.
